description: numpy.random.SeedSequence (pool, generate_state, spawn), PCG64.random_raw, default_rng(seed).random(n), .uniform(low, high, n), and Generator.shuffle(arange(n))

comparison.why: PCG64 (XSL-RR 128/64) and SeedSequence are integer algorithms ported exactly; random() is (next_u64 >> 11) * 2^-53 and uniform is low + (high - low) * random(). Shuffle (Fisher-Yates with random_interval) matches for this NumPy version but is NOT promised bit-identical across NumPy versions; normal draws are not implemented bit-identically
